description:
One exact MCP tarball is packed, clean-installed, protocol-smoked, attested, and retained from the freeze SHA without registry mutation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: After identity preflight, the supported Node/npm pair runs tests and exactly one npm pack --json, retains its path/integrity, installs it into a clean prefix, and runs installed jit-mcp-server initialize/tools-list with the frozen native jit candidate on PATH.
- [hard] REQ-02: A verified GitHub attestation binds tarball digest to freeze/event/workflow/repository identity; tarball/evidence upload once with 90-day retention and exact ID/ZIP digest/expiry. Changed bytes, second pack/upload, conflicting public 1.0.0, or provenance mismatch fails.
- [hard] REQ-03: This work performs no registry command, source repack, source edit, tag creation, or public mutation.

## Notes

Blast radius: one exact MCP tarball and evidence only.
title: Build and attest the frozen MCP candidate
